physical_reboot.scope_note: The real X230 reboot used the previously installed 4dad61e7 controller and was reverified independently. Job/PTY reboot semantics were not changed by this release; final release calls rechecked the same interrupted job and exact archive. No additional disruptive reboot, controller-host reboot or cold power cycle is claimed.

application_checkpoint_test.scope: application-supported checkpoint/drain/resume, not transparent live-pipe migration

dc_handoff.old_sessions_classification: Previously identified business sessions have exited naturally; they were not killed or falsely labelled live-migrated.
dc_handoff.scope_note: DC starts the actual fixture with known input; it checkpoints and exits normally. Native MCP starts a different PID, restores the journal, recognizes an old command and adds only one new effect. This is application-supported handoff, not copying live pipes/memory.
dc_handoff.initial_input_fixture_failures: Two disposable no-effect interactive fixtures could not be found by the DC input-session API. Their identities were verified and only those unused fixtures were terminated. The successful fixture used an explicit input pipe; this is not hidden as a successful interactive DC-session migration.

new_capabilities.metadata: Binary and document replacements preserve supported UID/GID/mode, Linux ACL/xattrs and Darwin ACL/xattrs through descriptor-bound capture/copy/verification under existing account permissions.
new_capabilities.rich_documents: HTML/Markdown/CSS/inline SVG and explicitly SHA256-bound assets render to PDF and native page images. No implicit network/local resource fetching or script execution.
new_capabilities.legacy_xls: Actual legacy XLS stored values, Unicode, dates and number formats are read without macros. Stored formula values are not claimed as freshly calculated.
new_capabilities.calculation: The bounded offline formulas engine actually evaluates qualified ordinary cross-sheet formulas and writes caches while retaining formula text and unselected OOXML payloads. Strings that resemble errors are distinct from real error tokens.
new_capabilities.native_cli: The installed hepta-runtime-call command uses existing private loopback authentication and native MCP directly; no DC protocol or cloud registration is required for new jobs.

independent_bug_fix.bug: Literal formula text ="#N/A" was incorrectly serialized as an error-typed cell.
independent_bug_fix.fix: Use actual XlError token type rather than matching string spelling; added propagation/type assertions.
independent_bug_fix.additional_fail_closed_case: 1904-date-system calculations are refused rather than silently using 1900 serial-date semantics.
